title: Payment Failed but Customer Sees Money Debited
agent_context: Customer sees money deducted even though the payment failed, likely a pending authorization. Reassure without dismissing, confirm minimal transaction details (pending vs posted), explain reversal timelines, and escalate if it settles or exceeds SLA.

raw_content.initial_message: My payment failed but the money is already deducted.
raw_content.context: Customer sees debit after a failed payment attempt. Often this is a pending authorization that reverses automatically. Policy: reassure without dismissing, verify transaction details, avoid asking for full card numbers, explain expected timelines, and offer escalation if it doesn’t resolve in the SLA window.

learning_objectives: Explain pending authorizations clearly without sounding dismissive
Collect minimal details needed for investigation
Set realistic expectations and next update time
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge frustration and reassure customer you will help
Confirm what they see: amount, timestamp, bank name, and pending vs posted
Explain temporary authorization hold and auto-reversal behavior
Clarify reversal timeline and offer tracking reference
Escalate if posted/settled or beyond SLA
Set next update time and confirm follow-up
common_mistakes: Asking for full card number or OTP

sticky_notes: HINT: Pending vs posted determines next steps.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if pending vs posted is explained with timeline and follow-up plan
